title: A place for durable thoughts
summary: Why this site exists, and what I hope to explore here.
coffee_html:
This site is a place for ideas that deserve more than a quick reaction. In the Coffee Time version, each note starts with the shortest useful path through the idea.

Why two versions?

Some days call for a careful deep dive. Other days only leave time for one cup of coffee. Both should lead to the same core insight.
content_html:
Technology moves quickly; understanding compounds slowly. This site is a place to keep the ideas that deserve more time: how intelligent systems work, how tools shape our thinking, and how engineering choices become social choices.

What to expect

Essays here will favor careful explanations over breaking news. Some will be technical, some speculative, and all are meant to remain useful after the week they are published.

Write to clarify the thought, not to decorate it.

This first post is sample content. Once the Notion connection is configured, published notes will appear here automatically.
